snippet.title: Dreadline Express Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Dreadline Express is a 1st-person, psychological horror metroidbrainia set aboard the last human train. Unravel mysteries of the enigmatic train, face strange passengers, and shape your path using a unique card-based mechanic that gives you full narrative control. This is no longer our world.

Play now on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3327120/Dreadline_Express/

Crew
Directed by:   Karel Vaněk, David Konečný
Script:    David Konečný, Karel Vaněk, Jiří Gerat
Actor:    Miroslav Černý
Camera:    Petr Kadlec (Marast Production)
Light design:          Ondřej Zunt
Sound design, music: Karel Vaněk
Edit:    Jan Dudáš, Karel Vaněk
Make-up:   Anita Palaščáková
Runner:    Jiří Gerat

Filmed in:   AVP UP Olomouc

Voices
Daughter:   Nina Souter Johnson
Wife:    Barbora Veselá (Mluvím na Baru)
Choir:    David Konečný, Karel Vaněk, Kryštof Kolář, David Longín, Andrii Hrykuliak

Dreadline Express, 2026
